# Adamson Geomatics — Full Documentation

> Adamson Geomatics (operated by Chris Adamson, R.I.) provides premier geospatial, GIS mapping, and land tenure services in British Columbia, Canada, and internationally.

## Executive Profile
- Principal: Chris Adamson, Registered Inspector (R.I.)
- Insurance: CAD $2,000,000 professional & commercial general liability coverage
- Jurisdiction: British Columbia, Yukon, Northwest Territories, Canada, and international consulting
- Official Website: https://www.miningpropertymaps.com

## Detailed Service Catalog

### 1. GIS Mapping & Spatial Analysis
- Cartographic production for NI 43-101 technical reports
- Multi-layer spatial analysis incorporating regional geology, geophysics, geochemistry, and topography
- Cadastral property boundary mapping, right-of-way planning, and access corridor design

### 2. Mineral Claim Staking & Tenure Management
- Mineral tenure registration and maintenance via Mineral Titles Online (MTO)
- Physical claim staking, boundary blazing, witness posting, and GPS tenure verification
- Assessment work reporting (Statement of Work) to keep claims in good standing

### 3. LiDAR, DEM & Remote Sensing
- Airborne and UAV LiDAR survey planning, point cloud classification, and bare-earth digital elevation models (DEM)
- Slope stability, fault trace, and structural lineament detection beneath dense forest canopy
- High-precision contour generation, hydrology modeling, and watershed analysis

### 4. 3D Geological & Resource Modelling
- Leapfrog Geo/Edge 3D implicit modeling of lithology, alteration zones, and vein geometries
- Drill hole planning, cross-section generation, and 3D subsurface visualization
- Historic data digitization and validation from legacy mining archives

### 5. Property Brokerage & Deal Facilitation
- Turnkey mining property dossiers with geological summaries, tenure data, and assay histories
- Connecting qualified exploration companies and private investors with vetted claims and mineral assets
